primary_source.work: D. E. Rosenthal — Справочник по русскому языку. Орфография и пунктуация
primary_source.scope: Orthography §§1–62 plus unnumbered orthographic sections; Punctuation §§1–72 plus unnumbered punctuation sections
primary_source.policy: Primary-source completeness was not frozen from derivative verification maps. The derivative verification-basis is outside the active workflow.

current_norm_gate.authority: Правила русской орфографии и пунктуации. Полный академический справочник / под ред. В. В. Лопатина, with current Russian Orthographic Dictionary/Gramota checks for lexical and variant-sensitive cases
current_norm_gate.principle: Where Rosenthal wording conflicts with current norm or current lexical status, preserve source provenance but use the current academic/dictionary rule in the canonical learner model.

orthography: Rosenthal orthography Section 19: selected foreign-word spellings — dictionary/editorial lexical provenance without an independently stable school mastery identity from this gate alone
punctuation: Rosenthal punctuation Section 13: period as rhetorical/stylistic structure
§53: paragraph layout of direct speech beyond the active direct-speech/dialogue engines
Section 16: newspaper/magazine headline punctuation as publishing practice
Section 21: special punctuation of represented colloquial speech
deliberately_excluded_source_blocks.exclusion_principle: These are not unreviewed gaps. They were directly classified and excluded because the frozen denominator models deterministic school mastery decisions, not publishing layout, authorial creativity or meta-description of optional variation.

important_current_norm_refinements: ДОЩАТЫЙ is owned by the productive current морфемное ск→щ branch, not a standalone memorized exception.
МЕЖДУГОРОДНЫЙ and МЕЖДУГОРОДНИЙ are both current normative variants; old exclusive wording is not taught.
ОТТОГО is primarily a pronominal adverb in the orthographic contrast ОТТОГО / ОТ ТОГО; the old conjunction-labeled card was absorbed by the adverb spelling system.
НЕ СОГЛАСЕН is modeled contextually within the current НЕ engine, not as a false context-free standalone spelling command.
ДЕРЖАТЬ В ВИДУ is not restored to the trusted learner core without current dictionary evidence; ИМЕТЬ В ВИДУ remains the stable fixed contrast.
The former imperative-soft-sign-before-СЯ/-ТЕ special candidate is not independent; it is a branch of school-verb-soft-sign-forms.
The old NI fixed-idiom HOLD is now resolved by exact Rosenthal §62 ownership and current academic confirmation.
BSP comma+dash remains a current possible sign but is low-productivity/declining in active use; teach it as a rare branch, not as an ordinary default sign.
